remarks: Looking For More Space In A Turnkey Condo? This 1-Bed, 1-Bath At Sumacpark Is Fully Redone With A Refreshed Bathroom And Newer Flooring. Unobstructed Views From Every Window. Nothing To Do But Unpack And Enjoy. Steps To Ravine Trails. A Smart Buy For Anyone Wanting Extra Room. Welcome Home.

Imagine a quiet evening on Sequoia Trail, where this two-bedroom, one-bathroom condo offers a functional layout with good bones. Broadloom in the bedrooms adds comfort, and a locker provides extra storage for your belongings. The building includes guest suites, making it easy to host visitors. Parking is not included, but the library is close by for weekend outings. The finishes are original and will benefit from updates over time. This is a solid, liveable home for an investor looking for potential. The unit is offered as-is.

Discover this inviting 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo apartment! Fresh paint and a new bathroom vanity complement the well-designed space. Perfect for first-time buyers or investors, it offers concierge services and is move-in ready. Located near parks and trails—make this your next home!

Sumacbank presents this 1-bedroom condo on Magnolia Lane as-is. The kitchen and bathrooms need replacing and the electrical is dated. A locker is included and there is an open balcony. One parking spot comes with the unit. This is a project for a buyer who is handy or a renovator. Steps to shops and restaurants.

Morning coffee at the kitchen island, then a short walk to transit. This 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo has been fully redone top to bottom. Custom kitchen with quartz counters and a large island. A den works as a home office. Custom closet organizers and window coverings are in place. The unit is about 514 square feet and comes with one parking spot. Nothing to do but move in.

A bright eat-in kitchen and a south-facing backyard make this 3-bedroom bungalow a great fit for a small family. The 20 x 56 ft lot includes an interlocking walkway out front. At roughly 1,500-1,699 sq ft, the layout is clean and cared for, with original finishes in good shape throughout. Parks and trails are close by, with places of worship also nearby. This is a move-in ready home on a quiet street in Sprucehollow. Call to book a showing.

Commuters will appreciate this 1-bedroom condo in Sumacpark. The bathroom has been refreshed, and the hardwood floors are refinished. Newer windows and ensuite laundry add convenience. One parking spot. About 562 sq ft. Close to a community centre. Move-in ready.

Discover this beautifully updated apartment in Cypressdale. New countertops and fresh paint enhance its appeal, while the kitchen, complete with a breakfast bar, invites culinary creativity. Relax on the open balcony or enjoy the convenience of an included locker. This well-cared-for residence is ideal for a family that needs room to grow. Grocery stores are nearby for everyday essentials. Embrace the comfort and modernity of this home.

A two-bedroom apartment on Cypress Gardens in Mulberryhollow that is move-in ready and wonderfully cared for. The building is well run, and the suite enjoys an unobstructed view that fills the space with natural light. One parking spot is included. Parks and trails are steps from your door, perfect for young professionals who value both convenience and green space. This is a home that lets you settle in and enjoy from day one.

Welcome to Oak Trail, where charming gardens greet you! This 2-storey townhouse has been well-tended and features a covered front porch. Inside, find a cozy living space perfect for young professionals. Explore nearby parks and trails for outdoor adventures. This is the home to start your journey in Willowglen!
